text: A data processing pipeline uses an Amazon SQS queue to buffer incoming messages before they are processed by an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function polls the SQS queue for new messages. Reduce the maximum message size allowed in the Amazon SQS queue.
Enable long polling by setting the WaitTimeSeconds parameter for the Amazon SQS queue.
explanation: Enabling long polling by setting the WaitTimeSeconds parameter (Option 3) for the Amazon SQS queue is the correct solution. This is a direct counter to the anti-pattern of short polling causing increased cost (Anti-pattern: ap-2.1-001). Option 0 (increasing visibility timeout) prevents messages from being processed multiple times but does not reduce empty receives. Option 1 (configuring a DLQ) is for handling failed messages, not for optimizing polling efficiency. Option 2 (reducing maximum message size) affects message content, not polling behavior or cost efficiency.

text: A developer is preparing a containerized application for deployment to Amazon ECS using AWS Elastic Beanstalk.
